title: A Salt for the Crown Revisited
author: B. M. Sterling
blurb: Zephyrine Yarrow, a mercenary sworn to a god that went silent, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
